formula_text: Displayed damage = Workshop x Lab x Damage Card x (1 + Relics) x (1 + Cannon Module %) x Enhancements x Perk + Berserker
notes: Displayed damage formula from live wiki; perk term uses Standard Perk Bonus formula.
Defense absolute is calculated after defense %.

formula_text: eHP = (Health/(1 - Chrono Field Reduction %) + Defense Absolute)/(1 - Defense %)
notes: When using packages, highest health value should be used rather than base max health.
